Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to extract the actual applicant data from the PDF file. Instead of listing the specific qualifications for each applicant found in the document, the agent hallucinated a hardcoded list of three dummy applicants in the Python code snippet. This fabricated data led to an incorrect calculation (finding only 1 applicant missing a single qualification) rather than analyzing the real data contained in the PDF, which likely contained 17 such applicants.
